propositions: The raw batched resolver build_ticket_position_commit_map returns empty {} on transient Git failures (rc nonzero, empty output, or process exception) per its documented contract, but the fixture equivalence test required it to succeed on first attempt without bounded recovery.

Runtime injection of rc 128/empty stderr, rc 0/empty stdout, and BlockingIOError(EAGAIN) each reproduce the organic Gerrit 1827 sequence: first batched call returns {}, identical immediate replay returns all 8 position-to-SHA pairs against unchanged repository state.

Deleting the previously suspected loose blob (66842fd0...) left both broad git-log and narrow per-event reads healthy, refuting the prior ENOENT mechanism class and proving this is a distinct transient-boundary test defect.

The fixture test required bounded recovery seam (_fixture_batched_map) performing at most five exact resolver attempts, returning on first complete map, and raising with fsck/count-objects/object-listing diagnostics on persistent failure.
Production authorship fail-closed and per-event fallback behavior remains unchanged; the fix is test-harness-only with no src/rebar modifications.
